note: Trophy names, descriptions and grades as published by Exophase, PowerPyx, GTABase and PSNProfiles; Rockstar has published no official trophy list. Guides are written in the author's own words and cite their sources; they do not copy guide text.

trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no extra task behind it: finish the story, work through the 100% checklist, then mop up whatever side trophies are left, and this one unlocks by itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
No multiplayer or DLC is needed.
It unlocks automatically once the last one pops.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start Chapter 1.
Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.
The trophy pops at the mission results screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 1; the trophy unlocks as Chapter 2 begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through all Chapter 1 main missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops when Chapter 2 starts.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 2; it unlocks as Chapter 3 begins.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through all Chapter 2 main missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 starts.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 3; it unlocks as Chapter 4 begins.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through all Chapter 3 main missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops when Chapter 4 starts.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 4; it unlocks when the final chapter begins.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through all Chapter 4 main missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops as the story moves on.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed, and one of only two Golds. Play the final mission to its end and the trophy pops with the credits. Keep a manual save from before the final mission: there is no mission replay, and free-roam continues afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Reach the final mission.
Make a manual save before starting it.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy and open free-roam.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 2 when you finish the main mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Chapter 2.
Play the main mission Breakfast Run.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 3 when you finish the main mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach Chapter 3.
Play the main mission The Cartel Heist.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you finish the main mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Play the main mission Child's Play.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you finish the main mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Play the main mission Headliners.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you finish the main mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Play the main mission VCIA Takedown.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 5 when you finish the main mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Chapter 5.
Play the main mission Operation Savage Glory.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the second Gold. After the story, the checklist opens at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is far more forgiving than it sounds: PowerPyx puts it near 60% of everything in the game. You need any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations and 15 of 18 meditations. Most of it falls out of the other trophies, so leave this for the end and check the list after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist in free-roam; story progress already counts.
Clear the partial targets first (vehicles, animals, stunts, challenges), then the all-of-them rows: 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations.

trophies.guide: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix them freely and pick the quick ones; PowerPyx calls the under-bridge flights the fastest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250. Track them under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Do stunts of any kind; every completed one counts.
Under-bridge flights are the quickest way to build the total.
Reach 250 for the trophy, then 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count at Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most of these happen naturally while chasing other trophies, so this usually pops on its own.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open Progress > Activities to see the 9 types and your count.
Try each type once: fish, hunt, golf, shoot, pool, basketball, play a video game, win a race, do a stunt.
The trophy pops on the ninth type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges. Push Square names two ranges, Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero; find them on the map under Activities, Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to gold, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. Track progress at Touchpad, Activities, Shooting Ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Find a shooting range on the map (Activities > Shooting Ranges).
Work through the challenges, golding each tier.
Gold all 42 challenges; locked ones show their unlock condition on the map.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total across those spots, and some charge an entry fee. Find the locations on the map under Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone spot on the map (Activities > Drones).
Enter and win the race at that location.
Repeat until all 14 locations are won.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not count, so keep moving to new locations; PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations. Track them at Touchpad, Activities, Racing. Most spots let you hire a car, and your own car's rating can be raised with Mod Shop upgrades.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Find race locations on the map and track them under Activities > Racing.
Win a race at a new location each time.
Reach 20 different wins.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing challenge marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his questline: Push Square reports the ask is a parrotfish over 2 kg, fished in the marked area. You need a boat and a rod; plenty of boats in the area can be borrowed if you do not own one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Play past Chapter 1, Feng Shui, to meet Cal.
Wait for Cal's text, then go to the purple fishing marker.
Fish the marked area until you land the catch that beats him.

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it. The home games are available from Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Pick one of the four video games: at home on the TV, or Bang For Your Buck at an arcade machine.
Play through all of its levels.
Reach the end of the game to pop the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline. It is Lucia-only and gets marked in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and then texts her home address in Belville. The five quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them are still available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: In Chapter 3 as Lucia, take Andy's call and follow the marker to Belville.
Work through her five quests in order.
Finish the last one, Puff Puff Pass, for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It gets marked in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams; Kenton calls and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure chests on the map: dive to the shipwrecks, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back. There are 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes away for a while in Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3, so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Take Kenton's call after Island Dreams and visit him in Key Lento.
Dive each marked shipwreck and bring the treasure back.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks; the final hand-in pops the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline. It gets marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. The five quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them are still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Work through Billy's five quests in order.
Finish Hometown Heroes for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. Not every side questline counts: PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Strangers stay available after the story in free-roam, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done. PowerPyx notes more qualifying strangers are still being found, so check the tracker as you go.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find stranger quest givers in the open world (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count).
Finish a full strand for each stranger.
Reach 8 completed strands; watch the trophy tracker count.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List. The questline gets marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City, starting with the Zorrusso you already delivered. Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, steal them and drive them back in good condition for more money. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to unlock the Key Cloner and the wish list.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK to find the ones Randy wants.
Deliver all 16 cars to Randy's garage.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline. It is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for synthetic labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest, and once enough are gone Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, which pops the trophy when finished. It is all still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 as Jason, follow the purple lab markers.
Destroy the synthetic labs in Take Out Kitty Litter.
Take Tyrone's follow-up quest Spin On This and finish it.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts as +2. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and on the map under Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida. A meditation only counts once its final zen animation has played. WARNING, POSSIBLY MISSABLE: PowerPyx flags one meditation in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. It raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest, so PowerPyx says it is currently unclear whether it is required for the trophy. Push Square lists no missable trophies. Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 to be safe, and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter. Only 15 of 18 meditations are needed for the 100% checklist, so this matters for the trophy, not for 100%.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony; choose Accept and meditate.
Meditate at each of the 18 marked spots; a spot counts only after the final zen animation.
Do spots with both Jason and Lucia where you can: each counts +2.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline. It is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Bret then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, and that all 15 Target Decks are needed for the 100% checklist, so work the whole questline. Track it under Map, Activities, Target Deck.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2 as Jason, take Bret's text and meet him in Lummox County.
Work through his hunting quests, bringing each animal back to Bret.
Keep going through the Target Decks; the trophy pops on the qualifying hunt.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Track your cards under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. Cards you find can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward your sets. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this pops naturally on the way there.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards around Leonida; track sets under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Finish every card in any one set, then repeat.
Complete 3 full sets for the trophy.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app: hold Up, then R1, while looking at a landmark, curiosity or sculpture. There are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags, so there are more than 100 to choose from and any 100 count. Track progress under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up).
Point it at landmarks, curiosities and sculptures and scan them.
Reach 100 scanned locations.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. View them all under Progress, Challenges, with a Completed checkmark on each. The 100% checklist wants 70, so you can skip the hardest 10 entirely. Many challenges complete naturally while working on other trophies; leave the last few for the end and pick the easiest ones left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Check Progress > Challenges to see what you have already done.
Let challenges finish naturally while doing other trophies.
Pick the easiest remaining ones until you reach 50 (70 for 100%).

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. This only opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together: call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape the red heat zone; PowerPyx recommends a fast sports motorcycle, and driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. The trophy pops once you are out of the heat zone. It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vault robberies always bring 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Raise a 4-star wanted level together.
Escape the red heat zone, for example through the Ambrosia train tunnel.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level. Only after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break can you bring your partner along (hold Right, then Triangle). Hit robbery targets marked green on the map and keep the flashing red-and-blue wanted level the whole time; do not let it drop or rise into the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not come, hit a fourth. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a few items in each and break the safe with sticky bombs.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner and pick 3 nearby shops.
Rob all 3 in a row without losing the flashing wanted level.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop; hit a fourth if it has not popped.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or by scanning it, and scanning is the fast way: stand on a busy road, open the WAiNK app and scan every vehicle that passes. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this pops naturally. Track what you have found under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app on a busy road and scan passing vehicles.
Getting inside a vehicle also discovers it.
Reach 100 different vehicles discovered.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak spots are highlighted, while the purple focus bar drains. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, which extends the slow time, and wear body armor so you can step out of cover. Line up a group, for example criminals at a gang operation, and drop them quickly with an accurate full-auto weapon. PowerPyx reports the trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and it gets easier later in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Raise your focus level and stock Adrenaline and body armor.
Find a group of 5 criminals, for example at a gang operation.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and take down all 5 in one use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport, and fly it away. It must be a plane connected to a boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield; the easiest is at terminals E3/E4. Drive through a fence around the airfield, go up the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, enter the cockpit, drive backwards onto the strip and take off. The pop is delayed until you are about 1 km from the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the plane docked at terminal E3/E4.
Board it, enter the cockpit and reverse onto the runway.
Take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect a 3-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in the south-west of the map.
Enter the base and climb into a Rhino tank.
Shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without setting off the alarm. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks jewelry store robberies and the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors. Go in through the back door and choose the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door. Inside the backroom, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to unlock the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun.
Loot the safe with its code, kill the alarm and the footage, then leave unseen.

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape each time. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (wait at the cafe): it teaches the method and counts as your first vault. You tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase inside and the vault opens; go in fast, grab the cash, and hand a bag to your partner. After that quest, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 each. Every vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so have a fast motorcycle ready. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, and one vault can pay up to $205,000. This is a Silver in the tracker lists (PowerPyx, Exophase via PlanetGTA6, PSNProfiles); Push Square's guide page lists it as Bronze, which would break the 1/2/6/46 split.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.
Buy van tips from Yasmani ($10,000) to find more vaults.
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time (8 for the 100% checklist).

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. The easiest way is the same Chapter 4 optional mission that opens bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is: tailing the security van to a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. You can also do it earlier in free-roam: block an armored truck driving near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Either play That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4, or find an armored truck near a bank.
Blow its back door with a sticky bomb and take the cash.
Escape the red heat radius to pop the trophy.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is entirely visible. Work region by region so you can see which patches are left, and finish the corners and islands last.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Get a plane.
Fly over every fogged patch of the map, region by region.
Keep going until no black fog is left.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many get marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs. You only need 1 per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find illegal operations marked yellow on the map.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Check Progress > Gangs to see which gang is still missing.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. The trophy pops as you drink with the view in front of you.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. Only this car works: it is an easter egg for the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack into the Banshee, drive forward through the glass, and the trophy pops a moment later once you are out on the street.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS).
Go to the showroom in south Vice City and take the blue Banshee.
Drive it straight through the showroom window.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. The luxury watch is in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 is on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe is in the north-east hallway: blow it with sticky bombs, bought at Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick the third item. You can do it during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and if you miss an item the robbery icon respawns after a long while, so you can come back for the rest. It is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn with sticky bombs.
Take the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe contents.
Escape the police; the trophy pops after the escape.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This only opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, then Strength (heart icon). Buy a gym membership and always train together: call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle) and while you work out, the other trains automatically, so you make double progress. There are fitness clubs all over Vice City; filter for them on the map under Activities.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: After Coffee Break, buy a gym membership.
Always bring your partner when you train (hold Right + Triangle).
Raise both characters to maximum strength.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile on): every time you do something that changes your reputation a small demon face appears on screen. Robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes, fights and kills all count, and it builds passively while you work on the other trophies. If it is the last one left, the fastest way PowerPyx notes is running over civilians and cops with a car, but that pushes your profile toward Psycho or the permanent Irredeemable status, which makes cops shoot on sight.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI.
Play normally; robberies and fights all add to the 500.
Check the count on the trophy itself; finish the remainder in free-roam.

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED, description only. As of 19 November 2026 no tracker confirms how this trophy unlocks. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Do not follow any method you see for it until a tracker confirms it; this guide will not invent one.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: No confirmed method yet.
PowerPyx believes it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
Wait for a tracker confirmation before chasing it.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2 AM. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted: talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside as she asks. The trophy pops then.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2 AM.
Look for the blinking car; if it is missing, leave and return.
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, help the woman it drops, and return to her car.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED, description only. As of 19 November 2026 no tracker confirms how this trophy unlocks. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Do not follow any method you see for it until a tracker confirms it; this guide will not invent one.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: No confirmed method yet.
PowerPyx believes it involves kicking enemies from a motorcycle.
Wait for a tracker confirmation before chasing it.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew: it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative across robberies, so you do not need $250,000 at once. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally while doing the vaults for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Deliver $250,000 in total to a fence (Yasmani pays best).

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. It is cumulative and counts every shop type. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods and tattoos. Find shops on the map under Touchpad, Style.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend money in any shops; the total is cumulative.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to reach $100,000.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 in total. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. The eight are Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Bonita Court Garage ($34,000), Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800). Garages store vehicles you register, and each adds parking spots. There are also 4 story garages, which do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy each of the 8 garages through the app.
The trophy pops on the eighth purchase ($160,000 total).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles with the Scooter Bros app, which is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. The app delivers your registered vehicles to you for a small fee. Register a stolen vehicle at Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn (Respray, then Register) or, from Chapter 3, at any Pay 'n' Spray for cars with standard trackers. You need enough garage parking spots first, so buy garages if you run out. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to get the Scooter Bros app.
Make sure you have free garage spots.
Register 10 different vehicles at Moses' garage or a Pay 'n' Spray.
